Beyond that, I see a wave of radiant golden light.
在它们身后，我看见了一道波动的金色光芒。

<Is that... the Golden Bough?>
<那是……金枝？>

Just as I begin to approach it, the apple begins to tremble.
当我正要靠近的时候，苹果突然颤动了起来。

Even though I had clearly seen it devour her, I couldn’t stop myself from asking.
尽管亲眼目睹了她被吞噬的场景，但我还是急忙问道。
